company.name: AS3A
company.shortDescription: AS3A is a digital platform connects businesses with flixable employees by hours.
company.description: Welcome to AS3A, a digital platform and strategic partner under the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development's "Flexible Work" system, where employers and Saudi nationals seeking part-time or flexible work opportunities unite. Collaborating closely with the Ministry of Tourism, AS3A's platform strives to revolutionize the nation's workforce by enhancing efficiency and employability. Their customized staffing and training solutions empower job seekers and employers alike, optimizing the nation's workforce potential.
